name: Lark
tagline: One suite for chat, docs, and video that still waits for you to run it

metaTitle: Best Lark Alternative: Source-Available AI Assistant
metaDescription: Looking for a Lark alternative? GAIA is source-available AI that triages email, manages tasks, and runs workflows across 50+ tools. Free tier included.
whyPeopleLook: Lark promises one suite for chat, docs, calendar, and video. It works when the whole team moves. Most teams do not move. They keep Gmail, Slack, GitHub, and Notion, and Lark becomes one more platform to check. People looking for a Lark alternative want AI that works across the tools they already use, without a migration and without manual rule setup.

faqs.question: Can GAIA replace Lark chat, docs, and video?
faqs.answer: No. GAIA does not provide team chat, video meetings, or co-editing docs. It connects to tools you already use, such as Gmail, Slack, and Google Calendar, and automates work across them. Teams that need an all-in-one suite still need dedicated chat and video alongside GAIA.

faqs.question: How does GAIA automation compare to Lark workflow rules?
faqs.answer: Lark runs automations you configure with triggers and conditions inside its platform. GAIA takes plain English instructions and orchestrates actions across connected tools. GAIA also monitors inbox and calendar context and surfaces next steps without a predefined trigger.

faqs.question: Is GAIA a good Lark alternative for privacy sensitive teams?
faqs.answer: GAIA is source-available and self-hostable, so data stays on your own infrastructure. Lark is owned by ByteDance, which raises data residency questions for some regulated teams. Self-hosted GAIA gives you full control over where data lives.

faqs.question: How much does GAIA cost compared to Lark?
faqs.answer: GAIA offers a free tier and Pro from ${{PRO_MONTHLY_PRICE}}/month, with self-hosting free for non-commercial use (plus your own model API costs) and no per-seat charge. Lark paid plans scale per user, so GAIA is typically cheaper for small teams that want AI automation without migrating the whole suite.
